note: v617: cooler projector (heat). At most 10 story objects on the stage at once (was 36); older ones walk off and new ones rotate in. The cap is one value (CAP_DEFAULT in stage.js; ?cap=N to try another). Pins do not count. The stretchy warp and the stage GIF/plate loop wake only when a frame is due (~4 fps warp, ~2 fps when idle or in cool mode) instead of on every display frame; name tags follow a cut only while a tag is showing, and that loop sleeps otherwise; off-screen cuts drop will-change so they are not compositor layers; map-pin pulse and the LIVE badge blink pause when idle or the tab is hidden. The video card still loops, and pauses only when hidden or off-screen.
